name: github-pr-publish
abstract: Agent-neutral workflow for safely publishing GitHub pull requests with gh, local git, and constrained GitHub REST fallback. It supports public and private repositories by using authenticated GitHub CLI access, preview-by-default command construction, explicit head branches, SSH alias-aware GitHub remote verification, guarded pushes, no-push explicit-head fallback checks, access diagnostics, and fake gh/git/ssh tests that prove no unintended mutation or credential leakage.
